name: @mcp-abap-adt/pg-vector-rag

hlido_opinion.headline: Reliable coding tool for ABAP developers — solid integration but lacks comprehensive documentation.
hlido_opinion.body: The @mcp-abap-adt/pg-vector-rag is a useful addition for ABAP developers looking to leverage vector-based retrieval augmented generation (RAG) capabilities. It integrates well within the ABAP development tools, providing a streamlined experience for users familiar with the environment. However, the documentation appears to be lacking in depth, which could hinder new users or those unfamiliar with RAG concepts. While it performs reliably, the absence of detailed guidance may limit its adoption among less experienced developers. Overall, it stands as a steady option for those already in the ABAP ecosystem but may not attract new users without clearer resources.

tier_rationale: STEADY (73) because it serves a specific niche effectively and integrates well within the existing ABAP tools. Not VITAL due to the insufficient documentation that could deter potential users. Would shift to VITAL with improved support resources.
